shorts.title: Hearts: pass the spades or the hearts?
shorts.question:
Which three
would you pass?
shorts.questionBottom:
The queen of spades costs 13 points.
Each heart costs one.
shorts.selectionBottom:
Get rid of the queen
and your two highest spades.
shorts.answerTitle:
No small spades
to hide behind.
shorts.answerBottom:
Keeping K♠ or A♠ could mean
winning the queen later.

caveat.heading:
But look at
those hearts.
caveat.context: K♥ and A♥ are still dangerous.
caveat.explanation:
Passing spades does not solve everything.
Reconsider after receiving your cards.

discussion.heading:
Would you pass
the hearts instead?
discussion.question:
Which three would you choose,
and why?

shorts.caption: Hearts players: which three cards would you pass from this hand? There are no small spades to shelter behind, but the high hearts are a problem too. Watch the choice, then tell us what you would do differently. This is one hand, not a rule to always pass your highest spades. Actual lesson cards from Barbu. #Hearts #CardGames
shorts.conversationPrompt: Would you keep the queen here, or pass her? Tell us your three cards and your reasoning.
